title: Cut automatic launcher host readers over from fingerprints to full source_id equality
outcome: Automatic launcher input checks and their TermAl host readers use only the launcher's existing complete admitted, before and after source_id values, through the shared validator and whole-object equality. Equal dirty source is allowed for this comparison; no automatic input fingerprint, .git/info image, replacement digest, independent parent expected-value copy or source-value fence remains. Explicit review-freeze identity and separate committed-input/landing policy remain outside this cutover.
acceptance: New automatic launcher run evidence uses only the existing full request.sourceId, results.sourceIdBefore and results.sourceIdAfter. Host readers validate these through the shared source_id type and compare the complete objects; they do not require, calculate or synthesize an automatic fingerprint, a .git/info image, or a replacement digest/encoding.

For the source-input comparison, equal full source_id objects qualify even with unchanged root or child local changes; explicit committed-input and landing policy remain separate. Any source_id difference, including a newly untracked path, cannot qualify; missing, unavailable, malformed or oversized evidence is not equality or PASS. Original command failures and unknown outcomes retain their existing meaning.

Cut over the existing focused-build reader, carried-run fixture reader, run index, wait/resume reporting, native completion input and test-run detail projection to the launcher's own admitted, before and after full source_id records only. Remove the parent-held independent expected-value copy and source-value fence; retain existing non-source run/directory/root/owner, argv, time, terminal, request/locator, claim and durability guards and bounds. Wait/reload, native completion and detail records may carry actual source_id observations within those bounds, but do not create or require an independent parent expectedSourceId copy. The public registration request remains runId and runDirectory.

Stored historical evidence remains readable as attributed history, without using old fingerprints as proof for a new source_id run. The review-freeze tool, reviewer identity, test-ref names and Review-Freeze trailer remain deferred and unchanged in this cutover; the new-untracked-only automatic-run exception is removed in the paired launcher change.

Focused regressions cover equal clean and dirty objects, root/child/new-untracked drift, unavailable or malformed evidence, wait/resume replacement, and preserved failure/unknown behavior. The exact candidate satisfies the existing independent review-pair and full-gate rules, with governed instruction passages concurred and audited under the existing policy if they are changed.
